branding.label: Branding
branding.hint: Site icon, colors and logo. Empty fields use the site settings (or the defaults).

home.label: Home
home.hint: Areas and counts on the home screen. An area stays hidden while its module is turned off.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.hint: Icon shown on the browser tab of user screens while this template is active.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.hint: Color of buttons, links and notice boxes.

color_scheme.label: Default color mode
color_scheme.hint: Mode shown to first-time visitors. Visitors who already picked a mode (including this browser) keep their choice.

logo_dark.label: Dark mode logo
logo_dark.hint: Logo used on dark screens. Leave empty to keep the site logo.

max_boards.label: Board menu items
max_boards.hint: Boards shown directly in the header. The rest go under More.

links.label: Shortcut links
links.hint: Links placed after the board menu (up to 5).

copyright.label: Copyright text
copyright.hint: Leave empty to use the default (year and site name). Empty languages use the default language text.

product_count.label: Products
product_count.hint: Products shown in each popular/new group.
